decisive_items: widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale
Skin biopsy: Showed psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis
response.rationale: Skin findings and biopsy strongly support psoriasis; hair/trichography findings are less specific and not classic for alopecia areata.

rejected.why: Trichography shows invagination, not exclamation-mark hairs typical of alopecia areata; skin features dominate.
